Class StandardIcons

java.lang.Object
net.emustudio.emulib.runtime.ui.StandardIcons
public final class StandardIcons extends Object
Resource paths of icons shared by emuStudio and its plugins. ICON_* icons are 22x22 with @2x variants; load them with GUI.loadIcon(String) or pass them to GUI factory methods. File names follow constant names.
